ORDINANCE Apert | '7, w24

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION |. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all the RT-3.5, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols
and indications as shown on Map No. 2-I in the area bounded by:
West Lexington Street; a line 186.60 feet west of and parallel to South Western Avenue;
the public alley next south of and parallel to West Lexington Street; and a line 211.60 feet
west of and parallel to South Western Avenue

to those of a RM-4.5, Residential Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Property Address: 2421 West Lexington Street
